title: Meeting Duke Ellington; a shared birthday and temperament
summary: Butler was asked to join Ellington's band but was busy; he says he and Duke share the same sign and manner and understood his music.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Now, you met Ellington during those years?
Oh, yeah, I met him many times, you know. In fact, I was asked to join his band but I was busy. And then later on in the story we'll get to that.
Well, how did he strike you when you met him in those early years?
Well, I was looking at myself, because
I'm from the same sign Duke is. same day--- I'm/ten years hence, but I'm the same -- nine years.

Yeah. Same time, have the same ways. And if you don't know me, I'm with you but I'm away from you. See, so (inaudible). I didn't penetrate. I know when I penetrate. See, I didn't penetrate. So that's what I -- I never penetrate (inaudible). But that is me. I hear the music that he's -- I heard it perfectly. (I understand/ Because sometimes I have things in my own mind I'm trying to find my way out of. So that is what happened.
